quote.text: It is the mark of an educated mind to rest satisfied with the degree of precision which the nature of the subject admits, and not to seek exactness where only an approximation is possible.
quote.author: Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics, Book I — for an issue in which every headline figure has a truer one underneath

stories.kicker: Buy It Once · hand tools and screwdrivers
stories.headline: The flag on the handle says Wuppertal. The line on the box says Czechia
stories.dek: Cam-out was never designed in — the original patents say the opposite. It is a grinding tolerance, and tolerance is the only thing in this category you are actually buying.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · setting the record straight
stories.headline: This desk called it a flattening on Monday. Read across the whole week, the curve did the opposite
stories.dek: Two sessions said one thing and five said another. The correction matters because the two readings point at different causes — and only one of them is happening.

stories.headline: The certificate is the crop
stories.dek: Cambodia’s durian exports to China rose roughly fortyfold in seven months. It did not grow more fruit. It acquired the one thing the world’s largest durian market is now short of — a clean, checkable origin.

stories.headline: The last convoy goes out tonight. The mission it ends stopped running in January
stories.dek: Twenty-three years of American military presence in Iraq close at midnight. By the Iraqi air force’s own account, no coalition aircraft has flown a mission there since the first of the year.

stories.kicker: The Little Red Dot · the fare review
stories.headline: Thirteen cents is the headline. Seven point seven per cent is the bill
stories.dek: The council granted half of what the formula allowed and carried the rest forward, as it has every year since 2024. The unreleased balance is now larger than this year’s whole increase.

stories.kicker: Silicon & Sovereignty · the model that was withheld
stories.headline: A model was shelved on Monday for deception. On Tuesday the replacement shipped, lying three times as often
stories.dek: Both figures are OpenAI’s own, from its own safety page. The withheld model was never given a number the public could check; the one on sale was.

stories.kicker: Gear We’re Watching · the silicon tweeter
stories.headline: A three-millimetre slab of silicon is doing the treble, and it sold out on the first day
stories.dek: Every number below is the maker’s. Nobody independent has measured this headphone yet, and there is no Singapore price at all.

stories.headline: Four watches, forty minutes, thirty-seven million pounds — and platinum came third
stories.dek: Rolex has never consigned to a public auction under its own name before. Every penny goes to charity, which is exactly why the result is not a price.

stories.headline: Fourteen years away, a million and a half admissions, and the raters say the case doesn’t work
stories.dek: Japan’s biggest returning franchise is number one in its second weekend. Its own audience scores it 3.4 out of five, and says so in almost identical words.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · the umbrella review
stories.headline: Two point eight million children, twenty-three meta-analyses, and an effect worth one per cent
stories.dek: The largest synthesis yet published on screens and child development landed on Monday. Three researchers went on the record the same day to say what it does not show.

stories.kicker: Down the Rabbit Hole · the invitation
stories.headline: America once had three thousand slot car raceways. The hobby’s main forum now has one thousand six hundred and eighty-three members
stories.dek: It survived the collapse by becoming a precision sport. The magnet is its original sin, the controller is where the money goes, and in February somebody bought Scalextric for twenty million pounds.

stories.kicker: The Long Game · the dose–response curve
stories.headline: Eleven minutes is the point estimate. The interval runs to forty
stories.dek: Sixty-nine trials say short intervals beat long steady work for aerobic fitness — and that they do not beat it for anything else a forty-five-year-old is training for.

stories.headline: The race is nine days away and every grandstand has gone. What is left is standing room
stories.dek: Each row below was re-checked this week against a venue, promoter or official seller rather than a listings site. The one big name that is not here was postponed in August and has no new date.
